newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up on rise in GDRs abroad.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up on rise in GDRs abroad.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open higher on Sunday after Pakistani global depositary receipts posted fresh gains abroad, dealers said.
They said Friday's rise in GDRs of Hub Power Co and PTCL was likely to boost bullish sentiment ahead of February 3 polls, which pro-business politician Nawaz Sharif is tipped to win.

On Thursday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100 index rose 6.92 points, or 0.48 percent, to end at 1,451.41. Gainers led losers 160 to 84. Turnover fell to 21.6 million shares from 25.4 million in the previous session. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
